display_title: A Friendly Schemer Brought by a Crime Writer
description:
"I can write it too! A sweet romance!"

Best-selling crime novelist Min Jung-yun chose a romance novel, the opposite of a crime novel, for his next novel. He was determined to write a romance thriller, but when he tried it, it turned out to be a romance thriller...?

Jung-Yoon's neighbor, Seo Kong-Hyuk, who is also a romance writer, lends Jung-Yoon a helping hand. Gong-hyuk has had a crush on Jung-yoon for five years.

"A date?"

"Isn't it time to let our love develop?"

Jung-yoon is falling for Gong-hyuk's tricks more and more.

How will they end up together?
